alt: The Artifacts tab of a session in the ELU terminal app: a chart of tests passing by run starts empty and fills in while the session works, until it reaches the target.

frames.caption: The Task names what to track: tests passing, by run.
/artifacts opens the tab. It is empty at first.
The session fills the chart as it runs the tests.
Each run adds a point: 36 of 40 pass after run 4.
The last run reaches the target: all 40 tests pass.
